profile.summaryJa: 列王記上12:21では、ユダの家と並べてベニヤミン族が名指されます。本文は、レハブアムが王国を取り戻すために選んだ兵士の出身集団として記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: カード対象は族祖個人ではなく、本文が名指すベニヤミン族の集団用法。地域表現は地理用法として別扱い。

facts.textJa: 預言者シェマヤは、ユダとベニヤミンの家およびほかの民に向けて言葉を伝えます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
“Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
